blurb: The Dance Space offers weekly social dances with DJ music and beginner classes included. They provide a variety of dance lessons including ballroom, Latin, swing, West Coast Swing, and disco. The facility also rents out its 1,600 sqft dance floor and sound system for events and private parties.
